<style>
    /* ===== Reset & Base ===== */
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
      color: #0f172a;
      background: #f8fafc;
      line-height: 1.65;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
      font-size: clamp(16px, 1.5vw, 18px);
    }

    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    button { font: inherit; border: none; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
    img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; object-fit: contain; }

    /* ===== CSS Variables ===== */
    :root {
      --max-width: 1400px;
      --radius: 20px;
      --radius-lg: 28px;

      /* Light Theme Glass (Homepage) */
      --glass-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.40);
      --glass-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(2, 6, 23, 0.12);
      --text-primary: #0f172a;
      --text-secondary: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.70);

      /* Brand Colors */
      --brand-blue: #2563eb;
      --brand-blue-dark: #1e40af;

      /* CTA Buttons */
      --cta-bg: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.90);
      --cta-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24);
      --cta-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28);
    }

    /* Dark Theme Variables (for alternating pages) */
    body[data-theme="dark"] {
      background: #0a0e14;
      color: #e5e7eb;

      --glass-bg: rgba(10, 12, 16, 0.65);
      --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      --glass-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
      --text-primary: #ffffff;
      --text-secondary: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
      --cta-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      --cta-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.20);
    }

    /* ===== Layout Container ===== */
    .container {
      width: min(var(--max-width), calc(100% - 2rem));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* ===== Header (Glassmorphic, Shrinks on Scroll) ===== */
    .site-header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      padding: 1rem 0;
      transition: padding 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
    }

    .site-header.is-scrolled {
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1.5rem;

      background: var(--glass-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    .site-header.is-scrolled .header-inner {
      padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
    }

    /* Logo */
    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    }

    .brand:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .brand-logo {
      width: clamp(50px, 8vw, 60px);
      height: clamp(50px, 8vw, 60px);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .site-header.is-scrolled .brand-logo {
      width: clamp(40px, 7vw, 50px);
      height: clamp(40px, 7vw, 50px);
    }

    .brand-logo img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain;
    }

    /* Desktop Navigation */
    .nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.25rem;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav a {
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: clamp(15px, 1.3vw, 17px);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: 999px;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav a:hover {
      background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.10);
      color: var(--brand-blue);
    }

    body[data-theme="dark"] .nav a:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .nav a.active {
      background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12);
      color: var(--brand-blue);
    }

    body[data-theme="dark"] .nav a.active {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    /* Hamburger Menu Button */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      min-width: 48px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      background: var(--glass-bg);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
      position: relative;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .hamburger:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16);
    }

    .hamburger span {
      position: absolute;
      width: 22px;
      height: 2.5px;
      background: var(--text-primary);
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    .hamburger span:nth-child(1) { top: 17px; }
    .hamburger span:nth-child(2) { top: 22.5px; }
    .hamburger span:nth-child(3) { top: 28px; }

    .hamburger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1) {
      top: 22.5px;
      transform: rotate(45deg);
    }

    .hamburger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: scale(0.8);
    }

    .hamburger[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3) {
      top: 22.5px;
      transform: rotate(-45deg);
    }

    /* ===== Mobile Drawer (Glassmorphic Side Nav) ===== */
    .drawer-backdrop {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
      z-index: 98;
    }

    .drawer-backdrop.is-open {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 100%;
      width: min(380px, 85vw);
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      z-index: 99;

      background: var(--glass-bg);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
      box-shadow: -20px 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);

      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      gap: 1rem;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .drawer.is-open {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }

    .drawer-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding-bottom: 1rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .drawer-nav {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-top: 0.5rem;
    }

    .drawer-nav a {
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      border-radius: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: clamp(16px, 1.4vw, 18px);
      background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12);
      transition: all 0.2s ease;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .drawer-nav a:hover {
      transform: translateX(4px);
      background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.14);
    }

    body[data-theme="dark"] .drawer-nav a {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
    }

    body[data-theme="dark"] .drawer-nav a:hover {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
    }

    /* ===== Hero Section (Galaxy Sky) ===== */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      min-height: min(85vh, 800px);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 1.25rem auto 0;
      background: #0a0e14;
      box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24);
    }

    .hero-media {
      position: absolute;
      inset: -6%;
      will-change: transform;
      transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1.05);
    }

    .hero picture,
    .hero img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
    }

    /* Premium Overlay for Readability */
    .hero::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;

      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;

      text-align: center;
      gap: 2rem;

      max-width: 500px;
      height: auto;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 20px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5));
      animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out;
    }

    .hero-logo-showcase img {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;

      font-size: clamp(18px, 2vw, 24px);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
      text-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease-out 0.2s both;
      max-width: 50ch;

        transform: translateY(30px);

      to {

        transform: translateY(0);

We believe the Bible is God's inspired Word and the authority for faith and life. We believe in one true God—Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. We believe Jesus Christ is Lord and Savior, and salvation is offered by grace through faith, expressed through confession, repentance, and baptism.

block_2.text_1: We believe Jesus Christ is fully God who became human to save us from sin. His life shows us how to live, His death redeems us, and His resurrection guarantees our resurrection to new life. Jesus is the only way to have a saving relationship with God.

block_3.text_1: We believe God not only saves us, but transforms us into His image as revealed in Jesus Christ. Transformation begins at salvation, is sustained by grace, and grows as our lives are increasingly aligned with God's will through the Holy Spirit.

Visit a Gathering

We believe in welcoming, respectful environments where everyone belongs. Come as you are. No pressure. Whether you've been in church for years or you're just starting to explore faith, you're welcome here.

Sunday Service: 10:00 AM

Adult Bible Class: 9:30 AM

Kids Service: 9:00 AM

Plan Your Visit

Join a Group

We believe spiritual growth happens best in community. We believe God transforms us through the Holy Spirit, and that transformation happens when we gather together. Men's and women's gatherings are open to all ages.

Community Men (Men) — Second Monday of each month at 6:00 PM
Community Women (Women) — First Tuesday of each month at 6:00 PM

Explore Groups

Serve With Us

We believe the Holy Spirit gives believers spiritual gifts to be used to help others. We believe the church exists to make disciples and serve our community. Outreach is one of the ways we live out our faith — showing up for our neighbors with hands-on love.

Volunteer / Serve

<style>
        :root {

            --bg-glass-light: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);

        header {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--bg-glass-light);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-glass);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-glass);
            z-index: 1000;
            height: 80px;
        }

        .header-container {
            max-width: var(--container-max);

            padding: 0 clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);

            height: auto;
        }

        .logo-img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            object-fit: contain;
            display: block;
        }

        .nav-desktop {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            align-items: center;
        }

        .nav-link {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: clamp(15px, 1.2vw, 16px);
            padding: 0.5rem 0;
            transition: color 0.2s;
            position: relative;
        }

        .nav-link:hover,
        .nav-link.active {
            color: var(--blue-primary);
        }

        .nav-link.active::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--blue-primary);
        }

        .mobile-toggle {
            display: none;
            background: none;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0.5rem;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
            z-index: 1001;
        }

        .mobile-toggle span {
            width: 24px;
            height: 2px;
            background: var(--text-primary);
            border-radius: 2px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .mobile-toggle.active span:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
        }

        .mobile-toggle.active span:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        .mobile-toggle.active span:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(7px, -6px);
        }

        /* Glassmorphic Side Navigation */
        .mobile-menu {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            right: -100%;
            width: 70vw;
            max-width: 320px;
            height: 100vh;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
            border-left: 1px solid var(--border-glass);
            box-shadow: -4px 0 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            transition: right 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            z-index: 999;
            overflow-y: auto;
        }

        .mobile-menu.active {
            right: 0;
        }

        .mobile-menu-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            z-index: 998;
        }

        .mobile-menu-overlay.active {
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
        }

        .mobile-menu-header {
            padding: 2rem 1.5rem 1rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-glass);
        }

        .mobile-menu-logo {
            width: 140px;
            height: auto;
        }

        .mobile-menu ul {
            list-style: none;
            padding: 1.5rem 0;
        }

        .mobile-menu li {
            margin: 0;
        }

        .mobile-menu a {
            display: block;
            padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-weight: 500;
            font-size: 16px;

            position: relative;
        }

        .mobile-menu a:hover {
            background: var(--bg-glass-dark);

        .mobile-menu a.active {
            color: var(--blue-primary);
            background: var(--bg-glass-dark);

        .mobile-menu a.active::before {

            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            width: 3px;
            height: 60%;
            background: var(--blue-primary);
            border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0;

        .mobile-menu-footer {

            border-top: 1px solid var(--border-glass);
            margin-top: auto;

        .mobile-menu-contact {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);

        .mobile-menu-contact a {
            color: var(--blue-primary);

Why We Gather

Every man is fighting for something or against something.

Some are fighting to provide.
Some are fighting to stay sober.
Some are fighting for their marriage, their family, their faith.
And some are just fighting to make it through another day.

But the truth is: none of us were meant to fight alone.

From the beginning, God made it clear: it's not good for man to be alone. We were created for connection — not weakness, but strength through brotherhood.

We gather because the fight within us is too great to face in silence.
We gather because when we open up, we realize we're not alone.
We gather because when one brother falls, another helps him rise.

When stories are shared, something holy happens: walls come down, shame loses power, truth takes root — and God forms men who stand shoulder-to-shoulder: strong, humble, and free.

That's why we call it Community Men — not because we're looking for a fight… but because we've already found one:

Faith Lived, Not Just Spoken

We believe the church exists to make disciples and serve our community. We believe faith isn't just something we believe — it's something we live. That's why Model City Missions exists: to show up for our neighbors with hands-on love.

Since 2017, volunteers from River Parish and across the country have come together each year to paint, renovate, and restore local homes — completely free — for families in our community. This is faith in action: serving alongside our friends and neighbors, making River Parish a better place to live.

What It Is

We believe in living the love of Christ publicly. Model City Missions is a community outreach effort focused on home improvement and neighborhood restoration. Volunteers work side-by-side to paint, repair, and renew homes for local residents at no cost — because loving your neighbor means showing up for them.

This is how we live out what we believe: that God transforms lives through service, that the Holy Spirit empowers us to help others, and that the church is called to be the hands and feet of Jesus in our community.

We believe God transforms us into His image as revealed in Jesus Christ. Transformation begins at salvation, is sustained by grace, and grows as our lives are increasingly aligned with God's will. We see that transformation happening in the next generation.

Every summer, around 50 youth volunteers join the mission — including groups from River Parish and out of state (Texas, Oregon, Oklahoma and more). This is what it looks like when young people understand that following Jesus means serving others.

content.text_1: A welcoming space for women to gather, grow, and build lasting connection.

sections.name: Event Details
sections.html:
Event Details

When: First Tuesday of every month

Time: 6:00 PM

Who: Women of all ages

What: Community + encouragement + shared life + free food

Community Women is a women's gathering centered on meaningful relationships and multigenerational community. On the first Tuesday of every month, women come together to connect, share life, and grow deeper in Christ — through real conversation, encouragement, and friendship.

Community Women is for women who want community that feels real — not forced. Whether you're new to the area, looking for deeper relationships, or simply needing a place to belong, Community Women is for you. Come as you are. Bring a friend. Become Community Women in Christ.
